```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

generate_heatmap_interactive5 <- function(
    repo_local_dir,
    figure_path,
    timepoint = "post_3.5_4_hr"
) {
  
  # ---- Load required libraries ----
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "tidyr", "ComplexHeatmap", "circlize", "RColorBrewer",
    "grid", "openxlsx", "stringr", "purrr"
  )
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  
  plot_dir  <- dirname(figure_path)
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  # ---- Step 1: Load DA data ----
  df_da_full <- load_differential_analysis(
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    selected_omes = "all",
    selected_tissues = "all",
    single_matrix = TRUE,
    combine_with_featgene = TRUE,
    epigen = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(contrast_type == "exercise_with_controls") %>%
    mutate(
      assay = if_else(str_detect(assay, "metab"), "metab", assay),
      gene_symbol = if_else(assay == "metab", feature_id, gene_symbol)
    )
  
  color_exercise <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_EXERCISE_GROUP_COLORS
  color_resist <- color_exercise[["ADUResist"]]
  color_endur  <- color_exercise[["ADUEndur"]]
  color_control <- color_exercise[["ADUControl"]]
  
  # ---- Step 2: Split DA data by tissue and assay ----
  da_fil_data_bp <- df_da_full %>% filter(tissue == "blood", assay == "prot-ol")
  da_fil_data_br <- df_da_full %>% filter(tissue == "blood", assay == "transcript-rna-seq")
  da_fil_data_mr <- df_da_full %>% filter(tissue == "muscle", assay == "transcript-rna-seq")
  da_fil_data_ar <- df_da_full %>% filter(tissue == "adipose", assay == "transcript-rna-seq")
  da_fil_data_mp <- df_da_full %>% filter(tissue == "muscle", assay == "prot-pr")
  da_fil_data_ap <- df_da_full %>% filter(tissue == "adipose", assay == "prot-pr",feature_id != "P04233-2") 
  
  # ---- Step 3: Select significant secreted proteins ----
  significant_assays <- da_fil_data_bp %>%
    filter(Timepoint == timepoint, adj_p_value < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Genes = gene_symbol) %>%
    distinct()
  
  gene_data <- drop_na(data.frame(Genes = as.character(significant_assays$Genes)))
  
  # ---- Helper function to extract DA ----
  extract_and_process <- function(data, gene_column, tissue_label, gene_data) {
    if (is.null(data) || nrow(data) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    if (is.data.frame(gene_data)) {
      genes <- gene_data$Genes
    } else {
      genes <- as.character(gene_data)
    }
    
    data %>%
      filter(.data[[gene_column]] %in% genes) %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(gene_column), adj_p_value, logFC, randomGroupCode, Timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::rename(feature_id = all_of(gene_column)) %>%
      mutate(Tissue_ome = tissue_label)
  }
  
  # ---- Step 4: Split genes into halves for divided heatmap ----
  n_genes <- nrow(gene_data)
  half <- ceiling(n_genes / 2)
  genes1 <- gene_data$Genes[1:half]
  genes2 <- gene_data$Genes[(half+1):n_genes]
  
  motrpactimepoint_colors <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_ACUTE_TIMEPOINT_COLORS
  
  timepoint_labels <- c(
    "during_20_min" = "During 20 Min",
    "during_40_min" = "During 40 Min",
    "post_10_min" = "Post 10 Min",
    "post_15_30_45_min" = "Post 15/30/45 Min",
    "post_3.5_4_hr" = "Post 3.5/4 Hour",
    "post_24_hr" = "Post 24 Hour"
  )
  
  # Keep only timepoints that exist
  motrpactimepoint_colors <- motrpactimepoint_colors[names(motrpactimepoint_colors) %in% names(timepoint_labels)]
  
  # Global Timepoint → Label → Color map
  time_colors <- setNames(
    motrpactimepoint_colors[names(motrpactimepoint_colors)],
    timepoint_labels[names(motrpactimepoint_colors)]
  )
  
  # ---- Global Tissue Colors ----
  tissue_palette <- c(
    "blood_protein"   = "#8dd3c7",
    "muscle_rna"      = "#bebada",
    "adipose_rna"     = "#fb8072",
    "muscle_protein"  = "#80b1d3",
    "adipose_protein" = "#fdb462"
  )
  
  # You want to keep the full palette globally:
  tissue_colors <- tissue_palette
  
  
  build_ht <- function(genes_subset, side = "left", show_top_names = TRUE) {
    da_bp <- extract_and_process(da_fil_data_bp, "gene_symbol", "blood_protein", genes_subset)
    da_mr <- extract_and_process(da_fil_data_mr, "gene_symbol", "muscle_rna", genes_subset)
    da_ar <- extract_and_process(da_fil_data_ar, "gene_symbol", "adipose_rna", genes_subset)
    da_mp <- extract_and_process(da_fil_data_mp, "gene_symbol", "muscle_protein", genes_subset)
    da_ap <- extract_and_process(da_fil_data_ap, "gene_symbol", "adipose_protein", genes_subset) 
    
    df_combined <- bind_rows(da_bp, da_mr, da_ar, da_mp, da_ap)
    if (nrow(df_combined) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    df_combined <- df_combined %>% mutate(row_id = paste(feature_id, Tissue_ome, sep = "|"))
    
    all_groups <- unique(df_combined$randomGroupCode)
    all_timepoints <- unique(df_combined$Timepoint)
    all_tissue_omes <- unique(df_combined$Tissue_ome)
    
    all_combos <- expand.grid(
      feature_id = genes_subset,
      Tissue_ome = all_tissue_omes,
      randomGroupCode = all_groups,
      Timepoint = all_timepoints,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>% mutate(row_id = paste(feature_id, Tissue_ome, sep = "|"))
    
    df_combined <- all_combos %>%
      left_join(df_combined, by = c("feature_id","Tissue_ome","randomGroupCode","Timepoint","row_id"))
    
    df_combined <- df_combined %>%
      mutate(
        logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
        adj_p_value = as.numeric(adj_p_value)
      )
    
    logFC_mat <- df_combined %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = row_id,
                  names_from = c(randomGroupCode, Timepoint),
                  values_from = logFC) %>%
      column_to_rownames("row_id") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    pval_mat <- df_combined %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = row_id,
                  names_from = c(randomGroupCode, Timepoint),
                  values_from = adj_p_value) %>%
      column_to_rownames("row_id") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    logFC_mat <- logFC_mat[, colSums(!is.na(logFC_mat)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
    pval_mat  <- pval_mat[, colSums(!is.na(pval_mat)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
    
    # col metadata
    col_parts <- strsplit(colnames(logFC_mat), "_")
    col_groups <- sapply(col_parts, `[`, 1)
    col_timepoints <- sapply(col_parts, function(x) paste(x[-1], collapse = "_"))
    
    timepoint_labels <- c(
      "during_20_min" = "During 20 Min",
      "during_40_min" = "During 40 Min",
      "post_10_min" = "Post 10 Min",
      "post_15_30_45_min" = "Post 15/30/45 Min",
      "post_3.5_4_hr" = "Post 3.5/4 Hour",
      "post_24_hr" = "Post 24 Hour"
    )
    col_timepoints <- ifelse(col_timepoints %in% names(timepoint_labels),
                             timepoint_labels[col_timepoints],
                             col_timepoints)
    
    
    tissue_order <- unique(df_combined$Tissue_ome)
    tissue_colors_subset <- tissue_colors[tissue_order]
    
    feature_order <- unique(gsub("\\|.*", "", rownames(logFC_mat)))
    feature_colors <- setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(length(feature_order)), feature_order)
    
    column_order <- order(col_groups, match(col_timepoints, unname(timepoint_labels), nomatch = length(timepoint_labels) + 1))
    logFC_mat <- logFC_mat[, column_order, drop = FALSE]
    pval_mat  <- pval_mat[, column_order, drop = FALSE]
    col_groups <- col_groups[column_order]
    col_timepoints <- col_timepoints[column_order]
    
    group_display <- c("ADUEndur" = "EE", "ADUResist" = "RE")
    group_colors <- c("EE" = color_endur, "RE" = color_resist)
    
    
    if (side == "left") {
      col_annot <- HeatmapAnnotation(
        Group = factor(group_display[col_groups], levels = c("EE", "RE")),
        Timepoint = factor(col_timepoints, levels = unname(timepoint_labels)),
        col = list(Group = group_colors, Timepoint = time_colors),
        show_annotation_name = FALSE,
        annotation_name_side = "left",
        show_legend = FALSE,
        annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold")
      )
    } else {
      col_annot <- HeatmapAnnotation(
        Group = factor(group_display[col_groups], levels = c("EE", "RE")),
        Timepoint = factor(col_timepoints, levels = unname(timepoint_labels)),
        col = list(Group = group_colors, Timepoint = time_colors),
        show_annotation_name = FALSE,
        annotation_name_side = "left",
        show_legend = FALSE,
        annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
        annotation_legend_param = list(
          Group = list(
            title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
            labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14)
          ),
          Timepoint = list(
            title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
            labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
          )
        )
      )
    }
    
    
    if (side == "left") {
      row_annot <- rowAnnotation(
        Tissue  = factor(gsub(".*\\|", "", rownames(logFC_mat)), levels = tissue_order),
        col = list(Tissue = tissue_colors),
        show_annotation_name = FALSE,
        show_legend = if (side == "right") FALSE else FALSE,  # legend only once
        annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
        annotation_legend_param = list(
          Tissue = list(
            title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"),
            labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold")
          )
        )
      )
    } else {
      row_annot <- rowAnnotation(
        Tissue  = factor(gsub(".*\\|", "", rownames(logFC_mat)), levels = tissue_order),
        col = list(Tissue = tissue_colors),
        show_annotation_name = FALSE,
        show_legend = if (side == "right") FALSE else FALSE,  # legend only once
        annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
        annotation_legend_param = list(
          Tissue = list(
            title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"),
            labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold")
          )
        )
      )
    }
    
    all_na_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(logFC_mat)) == 0
    return(list(
      heatmap = Heatmap(
      logFC_mat,
      col = colorRamp2(
        c(min(logFC_mat, na.rm = TRUE), 0, max(logFC_mat, na.rm = TRUE)),
        c("blue", "white", "red")
      ),
      column_split = col_groups,
      cluster_columns = FALSE,
      column_order = 1:ncol(logFC_mat),
      column_labels = NULL,
      column_names_rot = 75,
      row_split = factor(gsub("\\|.*", "", rownames(logFC_mat))),
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      show_row_names = FALSE,
      show_column_names = FALSE,
      row_title_side = "left", 
      row_labels = gsub("\\|.*", "", rownames(logFC_mat)),
      top_annotation = col_annot,
      row_title_rot = 0, 
      row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 24, fontface = "bold"),
      left_annotation  = row_annot,
      # right_annotation = if(side == "right") row_annot else NULL,
      column_title = NULL,
      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
      border = TRUE,
      show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
      heatmap_legend_param = list(
        title = "logFC",
        title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
      width = unit(8, "in"),
      cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
        if (is.na(logFC_mat[i, j])) {
          if (all_na_rows[i]) {
            grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = "#818589", col = NA))
          } else {
            grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = "lightgray", col = NA))
          }
        }
        if (!is.na(pval_mat[i, j]) && pval_mat[i, j] < 0.05) {
          grid.text("*", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, col = "black"))
        }
      }
    ),
  logFC_range = range(logFC_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))}
  
  ht1_obj <- build_ht(genes1, side = "left", show_top_names = TRUE)
  ht2_obj <- build_ht(genes2, side = "right", show_top_names = FALSE)
  ht_full <- build_ht(gene_data$Genes, side = "left", show_top_names = TRUE)
  
  ht1 <- ht1_obj$heatmap
  ht2 <- ht2_obj$heatmap
  
  logFC_min <- min(ht1_obj$logFC_range[1], ht2_obj$logFC_range[1],ht1_obj$logFC_range[2], ht2_obj$logFC_range[2])
  logFC_max <- max(ht1_obj$logFC_range[1], ht2_obj$logFC_range[1],ht1_obj$logFC_range[2], ht2_obj$logFC_range[2])
  
  # na_legend <- Legend(
  #   labels = c("Not measured", "Not detected"),
  #   legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("lightgray", "#818589")),
  #   title = "Missing Data"
  # )
  
  lgd_group <- Legend(
    title = "Group",
    at = c("EE", "RE"),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = c(color_endur, color_resist)),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"),  # bigger title
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16) 
  )
  
  # # Timepoint legend
  lgd_timepoint <- Legend(
    title = "Timepoint",
    at = names(time_colors),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(time_colors)),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"),  # bigger title
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16) 
  )
  
  #Tissue legend
  lgd_tissue <- Legend(
    title = "Tissue",
    at = names(tissue_colors),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(tissue_colors)),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"),  # bigger title
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16) 
  )
  
  # logFC legend
  lgd_logFC <- Legend(
    title = "logFC",
    col_fun = colorRamp2(c(logFC_min, 0, logFC_max), c("blue", "white", "red")),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"),  # bigger title
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16) 
  )
  
  # Missing data legend
  lgd_missing <- Legend(
    title = "Missing Data",
    labels = c("Not measured", "Not detected"),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("lightgray", "#818589")),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"),  # bigger title
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16) 
  )
  
  # Combine in order
  combined_legends <- packLegend(
    lgd_group,
    lgd_timepoint,
    lgd_tissue,
    lgd_logFC,
    lgd_missing,
    direction = "vertical"
  )
  
  
  draw_divided <- function() {
    grid.newpage()
    # Reduce space between heatmaps
    pushViewport(viewport(layout=grid.layout(1, 2, widths = unit(c(0.44, 0.44), "npc"))))
    
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.col=1))
    draw(ht1, newpage=FALSE, heatmap_legend_list = NULL)
    upViewport()
    
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.col=2))
    draw(ht2, newpage=FALSE, annotation_legend_list = list(combined_legends),
         annotation_legend_side="right", heatmap_legend_list = NULL,
         merge_legends = TRUE, heatmap_legend_side="right")
    upViewport()
  }
  
  # ---- Save to PDF ----
  # pdf(file = figure_path, width = 26, height = 20)  # adjust size as needed
  # draw_divided()
  # dev.off()
  
  cairo_pdf(file = figure_path, width = 26, height = 20)
  draw_divided()
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
generate_heatmap_interactive5(
  repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
  figure_path = file.path(plot_dir, "Figure_S6" ,"FigS6A.pdf"),
  timepoint = "post_3.5_4_hr"
)
```
